items.prompt: Create a 1536x1024 transparent pixel sprite atlas for SEEYA fan game. Reference 1 is STYLE AND LAYOUT ONLY: exactly 3 detached heads across top (each 512px column, y20-580) and 3 headless bodies across bottom (y657-1004). Same chunky square pixel geometry, tiny square eyes, tiny mouth, 2D hard edges, no glow/background/labels/text. Reference 2 and 3 are 2008-02-03 SBS stage wardrobe references. IMPORTANT FIXED COLUMN ORDER differs from the video: LEFT BORAM uses the yellow jacket outfit seen in video CENTER; MIDDLE GYURI uses pale pink/white tailored jacket seen VIDEO LEFT; RIGHT YEONJI uses the dark vest outfit seen VIDEO RIGHT. LEFT HEAD: dark brown/black hair tied low with wisps, black rounded fedora with wide pale yellow band and yellow side bow. LEFT BODY: yellow cropped long sleeve jacket with white large collar and cuffs, white feather accent one shoulder, white pointed shirt hem, wide black studded corset belt, dark navy straight trousers, black boots. MIDDLE HEAD: short black bob, bangs, small black fedora. MIDDLE BODY: fitted pale blush pink tuxedo jacket, white front shirt panel and long pointed hem, narrow black tie/ribbon, dark navy trousers and black shoes. RIGHT HEAD: long straight black hair and bangs, black hat with pale cream feather/ribbon. RIGHT BODY: white long sleeve shirt, cropped charcoal/navy fitted vest, wide yellow sash at waist, white pointed shirt hem, dark navy trousers and black boots. No microphones. Each body entirely headless with neck stub. Separate transparent gaps. Heads cannot overlap bodies. Crisp coarse pixels, same scale as ref1. This is a stage costume, absolutely NO hanbok.

Create a transparent 1536x1024 game sprite atlas matching first reference chunky square-pixel 2D art, dot eyes, 3-tone flat shading. Exact three-column TWO-ROW layout. Top row ONLY disconnected heads and hair in y40..550; bottom row ONLY disconnected headless bodies with little necks in y650..1000. Columns centered x256,768,1280. No scene, text, watermark, glow, no assembled characters. Truly transparent around each sprite. Uniform proportions identical to first reference. SECOND reference shows concert encore costumes: ONLY use THREE FRONT singers (front-left burgundy hair, front-center black hair white skirt, front-right brown hair navy outfit), ignore background dancers in white shorts and gray boots. LEFT Boram: long burgundy-red wavy hair, side part. Headless body cropped navy varsity jacket with WHITE long sleeves, white striped cuffs, navy cropped top, navy pleated SHORT skirt/shorts, black knee-high boots. Varsity jacket is essential. CENTER Gyuri: long black hair half up with wisps, headless body navy cropped short-sleeve T-shirt with a tiny white chest motif, white tiered ruffled short skirt, black knee high boots. RIGHT Yeonji: long brown side parted waves, headless body navy sleeveless fitted top and navy mini skirt with black belt, black knee high boots. Preserve the three distinct costumes and white skirt ONLY in CENTER. Straight arms down, no microphones, no props. Game pixel adaptation of observed clothing, not faces.

Create a transparent 1536x1024 game sprite atlas matching first reference's chunky square-pixel 2D art, dot eyes, 3-tone flat shading. Exact same three-column TWO-ROW layout. Top row ONLY disconnected heads and hair in y40..550; bottom row ONLY disconnected headless bodies with little necks in y650..1000. Columns centered at x256,768,1280. NO scene, NO letters, NO text, NO watermark, NO glow, truly transparent outside sprites, no full assembled characters. Uniform front-facing proportions identical to first reference. Wardrobe source reference 2 is Boram, 3 Gyuri, 4 Yeonji (named video clips; don't reorder). LEFT BORAM: burgundy red long loose waves, side-part fringe; body white asymmetric one-shoulder neckline, wide black buttoned corset waist, white wrap short skirt with long sheer side train, black boots. CENTER GYURI: long black half-up ponytail with wisps; white twisted halter with offshoulder draped white puff straps, black corset torso, short white ruffled skirt with a long ruffled side train, black tall boots. RIGHT YEONJI: brown long wavy half-up hair, tiny white bow; black thin shoulder straps, black sweetheart bodice edged white at neckline, white sheer drapes around upper arms, little white waist bow, white high-low skirt and black boots. Match differences of neckline carefully, no exposed midriff. Make all clothes elegant simplified concert costumes, not generic white dresses. Preserve pixel style and detachable head/body clear gap.

Edit this pixel-art achievement badge. Keep navy circular badge, cream/orange pixel border, transparent outside and chunky pixel art. Change ONLY its central fruit motif: make a recognisable TANGERINE silhouette built entirely of small ORANGE five-point stars spaced along its OUTLINE ONLY. All outline stars should be orange, not yellow, with pale orange highlights. Shape should be a squat, broad tangerine with a small dip at the top where a short green stem and two green leaf stars touch the outline. Width clearly greater than height, gentle flattened bottom. Leave the entire inside empty navy. No solid orange fruit filling. No single big star. Keep at most two tiny white sparkles well outside the fruit. No text. Make the stars a little larger for legibility at 80px badge display.
